description: Verify that DUT TCP sends the first zero-window probe after the retransmission timeout when the receive window remains zero (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.17)
approach:
[Objective]
The initial probe timing: DUT must wait at least one RTO before its first zero-window probe — not immediately, not arbitrarily late.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Handshake; DUT sends data; tester ACKs with zero window.
2. Wait until ≥ 1 RTO elapsed.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: zero-window probe within the RTO window.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted probe arrives within the RTO window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_seg1 — first data segment missing
• Fail_no_zero_window_probe — no probe within RTO window

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted first probe at RTO — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_zero_window_probe: No DUT zero-window probe within RTO window
